tracks.title: FADING INTO YOU
tracks.style: Melodic trap, polished modern production with spacious reverb and dark cinematic textures; fingerpicked acoustic guitar leads into ambient synth pads, deep distorted 808 drops, punchy trap kicks, crisp rolling hi-hats, vocal chops and haunting harmonies; intimate raspy male vocals in a high, light upper register, expressive autotune, vulnerable melodic verses and powerful full-voice belted chorus; 130 BPM with a driving trap pulse and bittersweet late-night feel.

tracks.title: Falling Into Blue
tracks.style: Melodic Deep House, Emotional Vocal House: deep warm rolling bassline, punchy four-on-the-floor kick, groovy percussion, shimmering synth plucks, lush atmospheric pads, subtle piano melodies; smooth, soulful female vocals in a dark lower register, intimate and breathy with stacked harmonies on emotional hooks and dreamy echoes; hypnotic 125 BPM pulse, melancholic yet uplifting, gradually building into a powerful melodic drop with euphoric synth layers; polished modern European house production, clean radio-ready mix.

tracks.title: Where We Fade
tracks.style: Melodic Deep House, Emotional Vocal House; delicate piano motifs trace half-spoken talk-sing rhythms over warm rolling sub-bass, punchy four-on-the-floor kick and groovy organic percussion; shimmering synth plucks, evolving synth arpeggios and lush atmospheric pads carry the hypnotic melancholic atmosphere into a euphoric melodic drop. Polished modern European house production, wide stereo, warm analog textures, powerful clean low-end, sophisticated arrangement and radio-ready mix; 125 BPM, spacious breakdown with piano and fading synths. Soulful female alto vocals in a dark lower register, intimate breathy verses and rising pre-choruses; layered emotional harmonies, dreamy vocal echoes and layered octave doubles lift the final chorus.
